title: Palindrome Permutation II
description:
Given a string s, return all the palindromic permutations (without duplicates) of it.
You may return the answer in any order. If s has no palindromic permutation, return an empty list.
 
Example 1:
Input: s = "aabb"
Output: ["abba","baab"]
Example 2:
Input: s = "abc"
Output: []

 
Constraints:

1 <= s.length <= 16
s consists of only lowercase English letters.

check_function:
def check(candidate):
    assert sorted(candidate('aabb')) == ['abba','baab']
    assert sorted(candidate('abc')) == []
    assert sorted(candidate('a')) == ['a']
    assert sorted(candidate('aaa')) == ['aaa']
    assert sorted(candidate('aabbc')) == ['abcba','bacab']
    assert sorted(candidate('aabbcc')) == ['abccba','acbbca','baccab','bcaacb','cabbac','cbaabc']
    assert sorted(candidate('aaaabbbb')) == ['aabbbbaa','ababbaba','abbaabba','baabbaab','babaabab','bbaaaabb']
    assert sorted(candidate('aaabbbb')) == ['abbabba','bababab','bbaaabb']
